attributes.context: This appears in a University of Washington side letter dated July 1, 2007, addressed to SEIU Local 925, within an Agreement effective July 1, 2007 through June 30, 2009, concerning the University's Kronos timekeeping system.

extraction_text: The University has the right to implement the "Kronos" timekeeping system sometime during the life of the Agreement. The University will notify the Union at least 60 days in advance and agrees to consult with the Union over implementation issues.
